reviews.title: Never went off during CO leak
reviews.body: Had an actual carbon monoxide leak confirmed by fire dept. This detector sat there silently. Dangerous product.

reviews.title: Stopped working after 3 months
reviews.body: Broke after just 3 months. Cheap quality plastic, fell apart when I tried to change battery.

reviews.title: Arrived damaged
reviews.body: Box was crushed, missing parts inside. Poor packaging for a safety device.

reviews.title: Not as described
reviews.body: Product looks nothing like the picture. Smaller than expected, feels like a knockoff.

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.body: Returned it after a week. Terrible quality, would not recommend to anyone.

reviews.title: Does the job
reviews.body: Works fine so far. Easy to install on the ceiling.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.body: Affordable and seems reliable. Time will tell.

reviews.title: Life saver
reviews.body: Detected a small gas leak early. Very happy with this purchase.
